argv: Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -match 'chrome|msedge' -and $_.CommandLine -match 'remote-debugging-port' } | ForEach-Object { if($_.CommandLine -match '--remote-debugging-port[= ](\d+)'){ Write-Output ('PORT|'+$matches[1]+'|pid='+$_.ProcessId) } } | Sort-Object -Unique
